Our Rider Pant is crafted from exceptional 15.75 oz heavyweight raw selvedge denim. Selvedge denim is woven on traditional narrow-width shuttle looms, unlike mass-produced denim made on modern wide industrial looms. This slower weaving process creates a denser fabric with a clean, self-finished edge that helps prevent fraying. It requires more time, expertise, and fabric to make, giving the denim its distinctive character and premium quality.
Because it is raw and unwashed, the fabric will soften and develop a unique patina over time, reflecting the way its owner wears it. No two pairs will age in exactly the same way.
